newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police seal off Paris law courts.
newsitem.headline: French police seal off Paris law courts.

text.p: French police sealed off the area around the Paris law courts on Tuesday after a man chained himself to a railing and claimed to have a suitcase stuffed with explosives, police said.
"Discussions are under way," a police officer said. There was no immediate indication of the man's motive or whether he did in fact have explosives.

France Info radio said the man's motives were unclear but that he apparently wanted to meet the head of the Supreme Court. It said he was brandishing a remote control but it was not known what was inside the case.
